name: com.unity.ugui
description: IndicFlow package for HarfBuzz-powered Indic text shaping in Unity TextMeshPro (UGUI), including Hindi/Devanagari support across Editor, Android, and iOS. Based on Unity uGUI 2.6.0 (Unity 6000.6).

samples.description: Optional sample Devanagari font assets and SDF resources for quick testing.
